City of Chicago
                                                                     O2023-1352
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 3/15/2023
Sponsor(s):                   Scott (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 2-J at 3217 W Flournoy St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all of the RT4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2J in the area bounded by:

       West Flournoy Street; a line 166.81 feet west of the west line of South Kedzie
       Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to West Flournoy Street; a line
       193.81 feet west of the west line of South Kedzie Avenue,

to those of an RS3 Single-Unit Detached House District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



                                            Monique L. Scott
                                            Alderman, 24"" Ward




Common Address:              3217 W. Flournoy Street (16-14-407-017)
